summary: Iter18 backend-only regression for engine boost fix (PERAHU trigger now sends cfg.boost_command to cfg.bot_username DM) and VIP verify-resume (_wait_for_message now calls _resend_pending_after_verify). Ran targeted unit tests (7/7), full backend pytest suite (184/184), and a live API regression against the public URL covering admin login, elite login, /api/automation/config GET+PUT round-trip (verified new fields: boost_enabled, boost_command, group_boost_trigger_pattern, bot_username), and admin create/delete user. All green.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/auth/register auto-issues a session cookie for the newly created user, overwriting the caller's existing (e.g. admin) session cookie. This is a subtle DX/security gotcha for admin flows and any test/automation that uses register-on-behalf-of; consider gating the auto-login to only when there is no current session, or adding an admin-side POST /api/admin/users create endpoint that does not swap the session. Worked around in the test by re-logging as admin after register.
Emails are stored/compared lowercased server-side but responses may echo mixed case-in tests. Consider normalizing on read-path everywhere to avoid subtle bugs.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_iter18_tmp@fishit.app during admin create/delete test; no persistent seed data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter15 targeted tests include test_boost_perahu_sent_to_configured_bot and test_boost_skipped_when_disabled which validate the engine change without a live MTProto session. The new /app/backend/tests/test_iter18_api_regression.py is a fast (<3s) live regression that hits the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL; safe to re-run. Note: /api/auth/register replaces the caller's auth cookie with the new user's, so admin-flow tests must re-login after calling register (already handled).
rca of the issue: N/A - both engine fixes (PERAHU boost dest -> cfg.bot_username with cfg.boost_command; VIP _wait_for_message re-issuing pending /mancing via _resend_pending_after_verify after pause) are covered by unit tests in test_iter15_group_reopen_verify_resume.py and pass. Live Telegram cannot be exercised in this environment as noted.
